components.name: CalendarMonth
components.description:
Figma `Calendar/Month` (16126:1093). Desktop: a Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px
`Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`, Corner-Radius/Base, clipped) holding the weekday row (Caption/Medium Neutral/Light,
Padding/XSmall, a Pale rule under it) and 5 weeks — 6 when the month spans six (Figma Sixth-Week) — of
`.Primitives/Calendar/Day-Cell`, Monday first; days of the next and previous month are Outside. A cell shows its events as
`.Primitives/Calendar/Event` chips: all up to three, else two and "+N more". Mobile: single-letter weekdays
(Caption/Medium Neutral/Light) over weeks of `.Primitives/Mobile-Date-Picker/Item` (DatePickerItem) with the event dot,
Gap/2XSmall between rows; days outside the month are blank.

Semantics: an APG grid — desktop: weekday column headers and a row per week of gridcells; each day's date is a button named
"Wednesday, September 30, 2026, 3 events" that selects the day (`aria-pressed`; today `aria-current="date"`). One date is
in the tab order; the arrow keys move a day or a week, Home / End to the week's ends. Event chips are buttons with
`onEventClick`. Mobile days are the date-picker buttons with the same keys.

props.name: month
props.description: The month to show (any day in it). Default: the selected day's month, else today's. Move it with the Toolbar.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected day (controlled): Day-Cell State=Selected on desktop, Single-Selected on mobile.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selected day at first (uncontrolled). Default: none on desktop.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the day the person presses.

props.name: events
props.description: The events to show: chips in the desktop cells, a dot under the mobile days.

props.name: onEventClick
props.description: Pressing an event chip (desktop): open its details, anchored to `target`. Without it the chips are static.

props.name: selectedEventId
props.description: The event whose details are open: its chip shows State=Selected.

props.name: onMoreClick
props.description: Pressing "+N more" (desktop): show the whole day (its Agenda or Day view). Without it "+N more" is text.

props.name: device
props.description:
Figma Device: `desktop` (a 7-column grid of Day-Cells with event chips) or `mobile` (date-picker days with an
event dot; list the selected day below with CalendarAgenda). Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: today
props.description: The day treated as today ("2026-09-30" or a Date). Default: the device clock.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the month (default: the month and year, "September 2026").

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the cells and days it draws (`{ "Week[0]/Day[2]": { more: 2 } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: CalendarToolbar
components.description:
Figma `Calendar/Toolbar` (16125:399): the control row above a calendar view. Desktop: Today (Button/Main Small
Tertiary), Previous / Next (Button/Icon-Main Small Tertiary, Gap/XSmall), the period in Heading/3 (Gap/Small after the
Today button), and the view switch (Segmented Secondary Small) at the end, Gap/Medium. Mobile: the title with Today and
the arrows (Medium, 40px, Gap/XSmall) on one row, the full-width switch (Segmented Medium) Gap/Small under it.
Only Tertiary buttons: the page's main action (New event) belongs to the page header. The title is an `aria-live`
heading, so moving to another period is announced.

props.name: title
props.description:
Figma Title: the visible period ("September 2026"). Default: the period around `date` for `view` (Week
"Sep 28 – Oct 4, 2026", Day "Wednesday, September 30, 2026"); on mobile the short form ("Sep 2026"), which fits
beside the buttons in the Mobile typography.

props.name: date
props.description: The day the views show ("2026-09-30" or a Date); with no `title` it names the period.

props.name: today
props.description:
The day treated as today: while the shown period already holds it, Today is disabled (pressing it would change
nothing). Default: the device clock.

props.name: titleLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title: one below the page heading. Default 2.

props.name: view
props.description: The selected view of the switch.

props.name: views
props.description:
The views the switch offers, in order (Figma: Month · Week · Day · Agenda). Hide views the product does not
offer; an empty list hides the switch.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view the person picks.

props.name: onToday
props.description: Today (Tertiary button): back to today's period. Without it the button is left out.

props.name: onPrevious
props.description: Previous period (Tertiary icon button).

props.name: onNext
props.description: Next period (Tertiary icon button).

props.name: device
props.description:
Figma Device: `desktop` (one row: Today, arrows, title; the switch at the end) or `mobile` (title and the 40px
buttons, then a full-width switch). Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides of the buttons and switch it draws (`{ "Today": { level: "secondary" } }`). Written by
Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: CalendarTimeGrid
components.description:
Figma `Calendar/Time-Grid` (16127:1172): the week and day views. A Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px
`Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`, Corner-Radius/Base, clipped) with three rows, each split by a Pale rule: the days
(weekday Caption/Medium Neutral/Light over a Large `.Primitives/Calendar/Date`, Padding/XSmall, Gap/3XSmall), the all-day
row ("All day" Caption/Regular Neutral/Light; all-day `.Primitives/Calendar/Event` chips, Padding/2XSmall) and the hours:
a gutter of hour labels (Caption/Regular Neutral/Light, 56px desktop / 44px mobile) beside day columns of 30-minute
`.Primitives/Calendar/Slot` rows (64px per hour, the hour rule on top), each column split by a Pale rule.
`.Primitives/Calendar/Event-Block` instances sit at their start time — y = (start − first hour) × 64 + 1, height =
length × 64 − 2, 2px from the column's left edge and 4px from its right — and overlapping events share the column in
lanes. The `.Primitives/Calendar/Now-Line` crosses today's column at the current minute.

Semantics: each day column is a group named with its date; blocks are buttons with `onEventClick` (named by title and
time). The header, hour labels, slots and the now line are decorative. Give the box a height (or max-height) to scroll
the hours under the fixed day header.

props.name: view
props.description:
Figma View: `week` (Monday to Sunday), `day`, or `3-day` (the day before, the day, the day after). Default `week`
on desktop and `3-day` on mobile; `week` on a phone draws the 3-Day grid (a week does not fit).

props.name: date
props.description: The day the view is built around ("2026-09-30" or a Date). Default: today.

props.name: events
props.description: The events: all-day ones in the all-day row, timed ones as blocks at their hours.

props.name: startHour
props.description: First hour shown (default 8: 08:00).

props.name: endHour
props.description: Hour the grid ends at (default 18: the last row is 17:00–18:00). Extend it for longer days.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time: the now line in today's column. Default: the device clock, updated every minute.

props.name: today
props.description: The day treated as today (the Accent date, the now line). Default: `now`'s day.

props.name: onEventClick
props.description: Pressing an event: open its details, anchored to `target`. Without it the blocks are static.

props.name: selectedEventId
props.description: The event whose details are open: its block (or chip) shows State=Selected.

props.name: onSlotPress
props.description:
Pressing an empty slot (pointer): the start of that half hour, to create an event there. Keyboard users create
events from the page's main action.

props.name: device
props.description: Figma Device: `desktop` (56px hour gutter) or `mobile` (44px). Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the grid (default: the period, "Sep 28 – Oct 4, 2026").

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the blocks and dates it draws (`{ "Day[2]/Date": { size: "md" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: CalendarAgenda
components.description:
Figma `Calendar/Agenda` (16128:1036): days in order, each with its events as `.Primitives/Calendar/Agenda-Item` rows.
Desktop: a Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px `Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`, Corner-Radius/Base)
of day rows (Padding Medium · Large, Gap/Large) split by Pale rules: a 48px date column (weekday in All-Caps/S, Large
date; Today in Accent) beside the rows (Gap/2XSmall). Mobile: per day a Body/Small/Bold kicker ("Today · Wed, Sep 30"
in Accent/Base, other days Neutral/Light), Gap/XSmall to its rows (Gap/3XSmall), Gap/Large between days.
Empty days are left out; a range without events shows an Empty-State.

props.name: events
props.description: The events; they are listed day by day, all-day first, then by start time.

props.name: from
props.description: First day of the range ("2026-09-30" or a Date). Default: today.

props.name: days
props.description: How many days the range covers (default 7). Days without events are left out.

props.name: onEventClick
props.description: Pressing an event: open its details, anchored to `target`. Without it the rows are static.

props.name: device
props.description:
Figma Device: `desktop` (a date column beside each day's rows, in a bordered box) or `mobile` (a kicker over each
day's rows). Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: today
props.description: The day treated as today (Accent date and kicker, "Today ·"). Default: the device clock.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when the range has no events. Default: an Empty-State Small, "No events".

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the rows it draws (`{ "Day[0]/Item[1]": { color: "teal" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: CalendarWeekStrip
components.description:
Figma `Calendar/Week-Strip` (16125:520): one week of selectable days. Dot: seven columns spread across the width, each
a weekday (Caption/Medium, Neutral/Light) over a `.Primitives/Date-Picker/Item` (desktop 32) or
`.Primitives/Mobile-Date-Picker/Item` (mobile 40) — DatePickerItem — Gap/2XSmall apart, with the event dot; the
selected day is State=Single-Selected, today State=Today. Tile: seven `.Primitives/Calendar/Day-Tile` sharing the width,
Gap/2XSmall. Days are buttons named with their full date (`aria-pressed` on the selected one, `aria-current="date"` on
today); the arrow keys move between them. Not to pick a date in a form: use DatePicker.

props.name: week
props.description: Any day of the week to show (Monday first). Default: the selected day, else today.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected day (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selected day at first (uncontrolled). Default: today.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the day the person picks.

props.name: events
props.description: The events of the period: a day shows a dot per event, up to 4 (Dot style; Figma Event-List).

props.name: variant
props.description:
Figma Style: `dot` (date-picker days with an event dot, default) or `tile` (weekday and date in one tile; the
selected day a bordered Surface tile, as Schedule/Day-Planner uses it).

props.name: device
props.description:
Figma Device: `desktop` (32px days, a side panel or picker) or `mobile` (40px days, above the day's events on a
phone). Default: from the breakpoint.

props.name: today
props.description: The day treated as today (Today ring / Accent date). Default: the device clock.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the strip (default: none; name it when a screen has more than one).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the days it draws (`{ "Day[3]": { event: false } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: CalendarEvent
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Calendar/Event` (16123:87): an event chip in a month cell. Padding 3XSmall · 2XSmall, Gap/2XSmall,
Corner-Radius/XSmall. Timed: `Color/Background/Support/<Hue>/Subtle` with Time (Caption/Bold) and Title
(Caption/Medium) in `Color/Content/Support/<Hue>/Strongest` (Brand: `Color/Content/Accent/Strongest`); Selected
fills Solid with `Color/Content/On-Colors`. All-day: Solid with the title in Caption/Bold On-Colors; Selected Rich.

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title: one line, truncated with "…".

props.name: time
props.description: Figma Time ("09:00"); not shown on an all-day event.

props.name: kind
props.description: Figma Kind: `timed` (Subtle fill, time + title) or `all-day` (Solid fill, title only).

props.name: color
props.description: Figma Color: the event's calendar. Brand is the default; other hues only tell calendars apart.

props.name: selected
props.description:
Figma State=Selected: while the event's details popover is open (Solid fill; Rich for all-day). Pair it with the
popover's open state and pass `aria-expanded` yourself.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Pressing the chip (open its details). Without it the chip is static text, not a button.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root element (a `<button>` when pressable, else a `<div>`).

components.name: CalendarEventBlock
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Calendar/Event-Block` (16123:130): a timed event in the week / day grid. Padding 2XSmall · XSmall,
Gap/3XSmall, Corner-Radius/XSmall, clipped; `Support/<Hue>/Subtle` with a 2px `Color/Border/Support/<Hue>/Solid` rule
on the leading edge and Effect/Overlay (a backdrop blur over the hour rules). Title Caption/Bold Strongest (2 lines),
Time Caption/Regular Base. Selected: Solid fill, On-Colors text, no effect.

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title: up to two lines, truncated.

props.name: time
props.description: Figma Time ("11:00 – 12:00"): one line, truncated.

props.name: showTime
props.description: Figma Show-Time (default true). The Time-Grid hides it on a block too short for two lines.

props.name: titleLines
props.description:
How many lines the title may take before "…": 2 (Figma, default) or 1. The Time-Grid sets 1 on blocks shorter
than an hour, whose height holds one title line (and the time from 45 minutes).

props.name: color
props.description: Figma Color (default brand).

props.name: selected
props.description: Figma State=Selected: while its details popover is open (Solid fill, On-Colors text).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Pressing the block (open its details). Without it the block is static.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root element (a `<button>` when pressable, else a `<div>`).

components.name: CalendarDate
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Calendar/Date` (16123:146): the day number in a Corner-Radius/Rounded square, Medium 24 in
Body/Small/Medium, Large 36 in Heading/4. Default `Color/Content/Neutral/Strongest`, Muted Neutral/Light, Today
`Color/Background/Accent/Solid/Default` with `Color/Content/On-Accent/Default` — the only accent on a grid besides the
now line. Visual only: the views name the day on the control that holds it.

props.name: day
props.description: Figma Day: the day number.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma Size: `md` (24, month cells and agenda) or `lg` (36, week / day column headers); short or Figma spelling.

props.name: state
props.description: Figma State: `default`, `today` (Accent Solid circle) or `muted` (a day of the previous or next month).

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<span>`.

components.name: CalendarNowLine
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Calendar/Now-Line` (16123:153): an 8px Accent dot and a 2px Accent line
(`Color/Background/Accent/Solid/Default`). Decorative: hidden from assistive technology. One per view, and only when now
is in the visible range.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Figma Orientation: `horizontal` (across today's Time-Grid column) or `vertical` (down a resource or Gantt track).

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: CalendarDayCell
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Calendar/Day-Cell` (16124:105): one day of the desktop month — Padding/XSmall, Gap/2XSmall, the
date (Medium), the Events slot (Gap/3XSmall) and "+N more" (Caption/Medium, Neutral/Light). It draws the right and
bottom 1px `Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default` rules (the month turns them off on its last column and row). Selected
tints `Color/Background/Accent/Flat/Default`; Outside fills `Color/Background/Surface/Alt`.

props.name: day
props.description: Figma Day: the day number.

props.name: label
props.description: The full date: names the date button in the locale ("Wednesday, September 30, 2026, 3 events").

props.name: state
props.description:
Figma State: `default`, `today` (Accent date), `selected` (Accent Flat tint: the day the user pressed) or `outside`
(a day of the previous or next month: Surface Alt, muted date, no events).

props.name: today
props.description: With `state="selected"`: draw the date as Today too (today is the selected day).

props.name: children
props.description: Figma Events slot: the day's `CalendarEvent` chips (at most three; with more, two and `more`).

props.name: more
props.description: Figma More: how many events do not fit. Above 0 it shows "+N more".

props.name: onMoreClick
props.description: Pressing "+N more" (show the whole day). Without it "+N more" is text.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Pressing the date or the cell: select the day. Without it the date is not a button.

props.name: focusable
props.description:
Whether the date button is in the tab order (the month keeps one day there and moves focus with the arrows).
Default true.

props.name: dateProps
props.type: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { ref?: Ref<HTMLButtonElement> } & Record<`data-${string}`, string | number | undefined>
props.description: Props of the date button (`data-*` the month's arrow keys read, `ref`).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the date it draws (`{ "Date": { size: "lg" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<div>`.

components.name: CalendarAgendaItem
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Calendar/Agenda-Item` (16124:373): Padding XSmall · Small (mobile XSmall), Gap/Small,
Corner-Radius/Small. Time column (72 / 48, Gap/3XSmall): Start Body/Small/Medium Strongest over End Caption/Regular
Light; a 4px Corner-Radius/Rounded rule in `Color/Background/Support/<Hue>/Solid`; Title Body/Base/Medium Strongest
over Meta Caption/Regular Light; on desktop the attendees (Avatar/Stack Small Subtle).

props.name: start
props.description: Figma Start ("09:00", or "All day").

props.name: end
props.description: Figma End ("09:30"); leave it out for an all-day event.

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title (one line, truncated).

props.name: meta
props.description: Figma Meta: place · link (one line, truncated).

props.name: color
props.description: Figma Color: the rule's hue (default brand).

props.name: attendees
props.description: Figma Attendees (desktop only): AvatarStack items (Size Small, Background Subtle, up to 3).

props.name: device
props.description: Figma Device: `desktop` (72px time column, attendees) or `mobile` (48px).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Pressing the row (open the event). Without it the row is static.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides of the AvatarStack it draws (`{ "Attendees": { max: 4 } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root element (a `<button>` when pressable, else a `<div>`).

components.name: CalendarDayTile
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Calendar/Day-Tile` (16142:3915): one day of Calendar/Week-Strip Style=Tile — Padding/XSmall,
Gap/3XSmall, Corner-Radius/Large; Weekday Caption/Medium Neutral/Light over Day Body/Base/Bold Strongest (Today:
`Color/Content/Accent/Base`). Selected: `Color/Background/Surface/Default` with a 1px `Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`.

props.name: weekday
props.description: Figma Weekday ("Wed").

props.name: day
props.description: Figma Day ("30").

props.name: selected
props.description: Figma State=Selected: a Surface/Default tile with a Pale border, readable on any canvas.

props.name: today
props.description: Figma Today=Yes: the date in Accent.

props.name: label
props.description: The full date, the tile's accessible name ("Wednesday, September 30, 2026").

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root `<button>`.

types.CalendarEventData: interface CalendarEventData { id: string; title: string; start: CalendarDateInput; end?: CalendarDateInput; allDay?: boolean; color?: CalendarColor; meta?: string; attendees?: Array<{ src?: string; alt?: string }>; }
